free_tier_limits: Accounts created before July 15, 2025: for 12 months, 2.25M connection minutes, 500k messages, 225k Registry/Device Shadow operations, 250k rules triggered, and 250k actions applied monthly. New customers receive up to $200 in credits; the free plan lasts up to 6 months.
rate_limits: Published per-account, per-region quotas vary by API and region. Current defaults include 10 TPS for ListThings and 10 TPS for DescribeEndpoint; some quotas are adjustable.
